verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is an international law firm. Its digital offerings are questionnaire-driven document generators (built on Contract Express) and third-party platforms such as HighQ, Legora and Luminance, not a developer platform. Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are therefore a category error for this kind of product, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt that would show the firm ships an API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
